description: Flat byte-level E1: E1's six mixers at d=384 on raw bytes, vocab 256, T=4,096 bytes, SWA window 1,024 bytes (about E1's 256-token span). Needs the flex-attention SWA patch (swa_impl flex): the dense-mask SWA at T=4,096 is O(T^2) (C12), about 6 GB of scores per layer.

budget.note: max_bytes counts training byte positions (B x T per step); token_equivalents = bytes / 3.735 (measured val bytes per BPE token)

notes: lr 0.006 = K7's tuned E1 value, NOT tuned for bytes: run the SQ188 LR check (20M-byte variants) first.
